question:
From 2010 to 2015, what was the average overall rating of players who are higher than 170?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: from 2010 to 2015 refers to strftime('%Y', date) >= '2010' AND <= '2015'; average overall rating = SUM(t2.overall_rating)/ COUNT(t2.id); higher than 170 refers to Player.height > 170;

prediction.sql:
SELECT AVG(pa.XCL_132) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE strftime('%Y', pa.XCL_131) >= '2010'
  AND strftime('%Y', pa.XCL_131) <= '2015'
  AND p.XCL_126 > 170;
